title: Data Mixing as Mixture Experiment: Response Surface Methodology and Optimal Design for Large Language Model Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2608.23922v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data mixing is a central design problem in large language model pretraining: given a fixed token budget, practitioners must decide how much data to allocate to each domain. Recent proxy-based methods address this problem by training small models on candidate mixtures, fitting a response model, and using the response to select mixtures for larger-scale training. We show that this workflow has the structure of a classical mixture experiment. Under this view, data domains are mixture components, token shares are component proportions, proxy-training runs are experimental design points, and validation loss defines a response surface over the probability simplex. We develop this formulation using sparse second-order Scheff\'{e} response-surface models and construct model-robust $\mathcal{I}$-optimal designs for proxy data-mixing experiments. translated_title: 数据混合作为混合实验：响应面方法与最优设计在大语言模型预训练中的应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23922v1 公告类型：新 摘要：数据混合是大语言模型预训练中的一个核心设计问题：在给定令牌预算的情况下，从业者必须决定每个领域分配多少数据。近期基于代理的方法通过在小模型上训练候选混合方案、拟合响应模型，并利用响应来选择更大规模训练的混合方案来解决这一问题。我们表明，这一工作流程具有经典混合实验的结构。在此视角下，数据领域是混合组分，令牌份额是组分比例，代理训练运行是实验设计点，验证损失在概率单纯形上定义了一个响应面。我们利用稀疏二阶Scheffé响应面模型发展了这一表述，并为代理数据混合实验构建了模型鲁棒的$\mathcal{I}$-最优设计。以RegMix作为实证案例研究，我们展示了该框架如何解释观测结果。
tldr: 本文将数据混合问题重新定义为混合实验，利用响应面方法和最优设计来优化大语言模型预训练中的数据分配策略，并通过RegMix案例验证其解释能力。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes data mixing as a mixture experiment, using response surface methodology and optimal design to optimize data allocation in LLM pretraining, validated through the RegMix case study.
